description: Every Renovate pull request is merged automatically once the checks required by the main branch protection are green.

The renovate-approve GitHub App approves only pull requests whose body says 'Automerge: Enabled'; Renovate writes that line when automerge is on, so automerge must stay enabled for the approval to happen.

GitHub's native auto-merge (platformAutomerge) merges the pull request as soon as the branch protection of main is satisfied, so the required status checks configured there define what counts as green.
